name: dsh-api-designer
description: DSH plugin to inject the api-designer skill into system-prompt persona, providing API design guidance for REST and GraphQL.

summary.en: Design clean, consistent REST and GraphQL APIs with best practices for resource modeling, versioning, pagination, error formats, and more.
summary.zh: 设计清晰、一致的 REST 和 GraphQL API，涵盖资源建模、版本控制、分页、错误格式等最佳实践。
